headline: Hindustan Copper Limited: Updates
sum: Updates - Hindustan Copper Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Prior intimation for Approval for raising of funds through issue of Equity Shares through Qualified Institution Placement (QIP) method and through to offer, issue and…
detail: Updates - Hindustan Copper Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Prior intimation for Approval for raising of funds through issue of Equity Shares through Qualified Institution Placement (QIP) method and through to offer, issue and allot, in one or more tranches, secured or unsecured non-convertible Debentures/ Bonds on private placement basis '.

sources.name: NSE filing - Hindustan Copper Limited
sources.blurb: Primary NSE disclosure (SEBI LODR Reg. 30 / regulator filing) for this corporate event.
